name: @xiaoqiong0v0/opencode-sound-notify
description: OpenCode plugin: play notification sounds on session events (idle, error, permission asked).

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const copyDir=(s,d)=>{fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.readdirSync(s).forEach(f=>{const ss=path.join(s,f),dd=path.join(d,f);fs.statSync(ss).isDirectory()?copyDir(ss,dd):fs.copyFileSync(ss,dd)})}; fs.mkdirSync('.opencode/plugins',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/sound-notify.js', '.opencode/plugins/sound-notify.js'); copyDir('assets','.opencode/assets')"
